title: Acceleration × Geometry Shared Spine
purpose: Lean-first shared route for acceleration proofs across Optimisation, Riemannian Optimisation, Statistical Optimal Transport, and Sampling. Formal theorem edges, compile-checked prototypes, source theorems, proof-pattern transfers, and research hypotheses remain explicitly separated.

shared_lean_spine.role: Geometry-independent algebra for combining independently certified primal and dual progress inequalities.
Scalar force cancellation and damping dissipation shared structurally by accelerated optimisation and kinetic sampling; not an ULD convergence theorem.

Expose oracle/score error separately from exact progress so stochastic optimisation and finite-particle sampling can share error bookkeeping without sharing estimators.

literature_lines.migration_rule: Do not call a general p!=2 norm Riemannian. Extract norm/dual-norm algebra first; quadratic Hilbert instances may specialize to Riemannian geometry, while nonquadratic instances route through Banach/Finsler/Legendre geometry.

literature_lines.separation_rule: Never identify Nesterov AGD and ULD as the same dynamics. Record structural mirrors, continuous-time theorems, and discretized algorithmic theorems as distinct graph edges.

hypergraph_extension.formula: weighted primal progress + weighted dual progress <= weighted potential decrease
hypergraph_extension.mechanism: Formalize coupling algebra once; each geometry supplies its own primal and dual progress certificates.
hypergraph_extension.failure_boundary: The algebra alone does not prove mirror maps, vector transport, displacement convexity, or stochastic oracle bounds.

hypergraph_extension.mechanism: Accelerated optimisation and kinetic sampling share a momentum/damping skeleton, while ULD adds phase-space stochastic forcing and degenerate dissipation.
hypergraph_extension.failure_boundary: ODE/SDE resemblance is not theorem equivalence and does not imply discrete sampling acceleration.

hypergraph_extension.formula: primal progress in ||.||_P + dual progress in ||.||_D
hypergraph_extension.mechanism: Extract Bai--Bullins norm/dual-norm inequalities before quadratic Riemannian or nonquadratic Finsler/Banach specialization.
hypergraph_extension.failure_boundary: Do not insert arbitrary G1,G2 into a Hamiltonian and assume original cancellations survive.

hypergraph_extension.formula: accelerated state + stable snapshot/anchor + variance/score error correction
hypergraph_extension.mechanism: Use Katyusha as a design clue for acceleration under noisy/inexact gradients; investigate reference-distribution or snapshot-score stabilization.
hypergraph_extension.failure_boundary: Katyusha is a finite-sum optimisation theorem; no sampling-rate transfer is claimed.

hypergraph_extension.mechanism: Lu 2026 creates a direct bridge from OT geometry into sharp kinetic entropy decay.
hypergraph_extension.failure_boundary: Exact source assumptions and normalizations must be formalized before promotion to a Lean edge.
